Name: NPC Relationship Tags
Author: mushymato
Description:
Allows players to add relationship tags to NPCs, this replaces the normal relationship tags like [font=Courier New](single)[/font], [font=Courier New](dating)[/font] etc. that are shown on the game pause menu social page and the profile page.

There are 2 ways to do this:
1. Open the social page on the game pause menu, then hold [font=Courier New]RightShift[/font] and click on the NPC to add or edit their tag.
2. In the profile page of a NPC, press [font=Courier New]RightShift[/font] to add or edit their tag.

You can also add tags to farm animals by going to the animals page on the game pause menu, then hold [font=Courier New]RightShift[/font] and click on the desired animal.

The key used in all cases can be configured via [b]EditTagKey[/b].

At the moment, you cannot tag the player (i.e. yourself).

The tags are stored in global app data instead of config, if you need to reset all tags, use console command [font=Courier New]npc-tag-clear[/font].

All in all these tags are cosmetic only and have zero gameplay impact.

[size=4][b]For Mod Authors[/b][/size]
You can reference the tag set by the player in various places such as dialogue.
To do this, use this tokenizable string:
[code][Mod_NPCTag <npcId> <fallbackValue>]
[/code]
For example:
- Original string: [font=Courier New]Hey we are [Mod_NPCTag Lewis buddies] right?[/font]
- Resolved, no tag set: [font=Courier New]Hey we are buddies right?[/font]
- Resolved, Lewis has tag "pals": [font=Courier New]Hey we are pals right?[/font]

You can provide default tags to show when the player hasn't set a tag yet, see [url=https://github.com/Mushymato/NPCRelationshipTags/blob/main/DefaultTagExample/content.json]example here[/url]. These tags are also valid for the tokenizable string.
